procedures.title: Frontier Built-in Grill Installation Requirements
preconditions: Voltage range must be between 35V DC and 55V DC
steps: Ensure cutout width is 11 5/8" (295mm)
Ensure cutout depth is 19 3/4" (502mm)
Ensure corner radius is 1/4" (6mm)
Allow for 1" drain fitting clearance below unit
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper installation clearance for model B70750

procedures.title: SilKEN Built-in Grill Installation Requirements
preconditions: Voltage range must be between 35V DC and 55V DC
steps: Ensure cutout width is 19 3/4" (502mm)
Ensure cutout depth is 11 5/8" (295mm)
Ensure corner radius is 1/4" (6mm)
Allow for 1" drain fitting clearance below unit
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper installation clearance for model B70770

procedures.title: Basic Grill Operation
steps: Remove grates and drip trays
Clean grates and drip trays
Insert drip trays into bottom of grill
Verify burner brackets are not resting on drip trays
Fill drip trays with 2 cups of liquid (water, beer or wine)
Re-install cooking grate
Close lid and preheat for 5-7 minutes
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill ready for cooking

procedures.title: Temperature Settings Guide
steps: For vegetables: Set temperature to 350°F or power setting 4
For chicken, pork and fish: Set temperature to 400°F or power setting 5
For hamburgers: Set temperature to 500°F or power setting 9
For steak: Set temperature to 550°F or power setting 16
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper temperature for specific food type

procedures.title: Post-Cooking Cleaning
steps: Remove cooking grate
Place grate in dishwasher
Remove and empty drip tray contents
Clean drip tray thoroughly
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grill components ready for next use

procedures.title: Fire Safety Procedure
steps: Do not use water to extinguish
Use dry chemical fire extinguisher
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe extinguishing of grease fire

procedures.title: Safety Inspection
steps: Examine power wires for signs of damage
Verify 30-amp circuit breaker protection
Check RCD operation (must not exceed 30A)
Ensure no flammable materials near grill
procedures.expected_outcome: Confirmed safe operating condition

procedures.title: Initial Safety Setup
steps: Read all instructions before using grill
Store grill indoors when used as portable unit
Ensure grill is kept out of reach of children
Provide shelter to prevent rain exposure
Verify power cord and plugs are undamaged
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill is safely prepared for operation
models: 48VDC Single Zone Grill with IntelliKen Touch

procedures.title: Basic Safety Operation
steps: Use only handles or knobs to touch grill
Keep power cord and plugs away from water
Supervise closely when children are nearby
Disconnect power when not in use
Allow grill to cool before cleaning
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe operation of grill during use
models: 48VDC Single Zone Grill with IntelliKen Touch

procedures.title: Drip Tray Preparation
steps: Add minimum two cups of water to disposable drip tray before grilling
Clean drip tray after each use
Allow grill to cool before removing drip tray
procedures.expected_outcome: Drip tray properly prepared and maintained
models: 48VDC Single Zone Grill with IntelliKen Touch

procedures.title: Cracked Surface Emergency Procedure
steps: Immediately switch off appliance
Disconnect from power source
Contact Kenyon Customer Care at (860) 664-4906
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe shutdown of damaged unit
models: 48VDC Single Zone Grill with IntelliKen Touch

procedures.title: Malfunction Response Procedure
steps: Discontinue use immediately
Disconnect from power source
Contact Kenyon Customer Care at (860) 664-4906
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe shutdown and support contact made
models: 48VDC Single Zone Grill with IntelliKen Touch

procedures.title: Verify Power Requirements
steps: Confirm voltage is 48V DC
Verify maximum current draw is 27 amps
Ensure power supply can deliver 1300 watts
Check voltage range is between 35V DC minimum and 55V DC maximum
procedures.expected_outcome: Power supply meets all electrical specifications for safe operation
models: No Lid Built-In Grill with IntelliKEN Touch™

procedures.title: Verify Installation Space Requirements
steps: Measure cutout width - must be 19 3/4" (502mm)
Measure cutout depth - must be 11 5/8" (295mm)
Verify corner radius is 1/4" (6mm)
Confirm total height clearance of 21" (533mm) including 1" drain fitting
Verify width clearance of 12" (305mm)
Ensure depth clearance of 21" (533mm)
procedures.expected_outcome: Installation space meets all dimensional requirements
models: No Lid Built-In Grill with IntelliKEN Touch™

procedures.title: Pre-Use Cleaning
steps: Wipe stainless steel surfaces with damp cloth to remove residue
Apply stainless steel cleaner monthly
Clean touch control area with glass cleaner and soft towel
Use ceramic glass cleaner for stubborn stains on control area
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grill surfaces ready for use

procedures.title: Grease Fire Response
steps: DO NOT use water on the fire
Smother fire or flame
OR use dry chemical extinguisher
OR use foam-type extinguisher
procedures.expected_outcome: Safe extinguishment of grease fire

procedures.title: Post-Use Cleaning Protocol
steps: Remove drip tray
Clean drip tray thoroughly
Clean baffle tray
Ensure no grease accumulation between cooking sessions
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grill ready for next use

procedures.title: Broken Grate Safety Protocol
steps: Stop using grill immediately
Contact authorized service center
OR contact KENYON Customer Care at (860) 664-4906
procedures.expected_outcome: Prevention of electric shock and fire hazards

procedures.title: Proper Cleaning Method
steps: DO NOT use pressurized water
DO NOT use other types of pressurized cleaners
Use only cloth for cleaning
Use only stainless steel or glass surface cleaner
procedures.expected_outcome: Safely cleaned grill without warranty violation

procedures.title: Initial Grill Setup
steps: Remove cooking grate and drip tray
Wash grill with warm soapy water using non-abrasive cloth
Insert drip tray completely into bottom of grill
Ensure electric element bracket rests on element support bracket
Add liquid (non-flammable) to drip tray
Place cooking grate or optional griddle onto element
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill ready for first use

procedures.title: Grill Preheating Procedure
steps: Close lid
Set temperature according to food type:
For steak - Set to 550°F / Power setting 16
For burgers - Set to 500°F / Power setting 9
For pork and fish - Set to 400°F / Power setting 5
For vegetables - Set to 350°F / Power setting 4
Preheat for 5-7 minutes
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill properly preheated for cooking

procedures.title: Post-Cooking Cleaning Procedure
steps: Place paper towels on grilling surface
Pour one ounce of water on towel
Use high temperature nylon tongs to swab surface
Discard paper towel
Wipe grates with dry paper towel
Remove grate when cool and place in dishwasher
Lift electric elements
Remove and empty drip tray
Wipe drip tray with dry paper towel
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grill ready for next use

procedures.title: Lid Cleaning Procedure
steps: Remove lid from grill
Place lid in dishwasher
Run on pots & pans cycle
procedures.expected_outcome: Restored pristine lid appearance

procedures.title: Cleaning the Grill
steps: Use a cloth to clean the grill
Apply stainless steel or glass surface cleaner
If cleaning hot surface with wet sponge/cloth, exercise caution for steam burns
Check cleaner label before applying to hot surface
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grill surface

procedures.title: Grill Storage
steps: For portable grills: Store indoors when not in use
For built-in grills: Provide suitable shelter to prevent rain exposure
Optional: Purchase cover from www.cookwithkenyon.com
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly protected grill during storage

procedures.title: Prevent Smoking During Operation
steps: Place 2 cups of water in drip tray
Ensure water covers bottom of pan
procedures.expected_outcome: Reduced smoke during cooking

procedures.title: Safety Lock Operation - Grill ON
steps: Activate lock feature
Power settings will be locked from adjustment
Press zone power or master power button to turn off grill if needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Locked grill controls while powered on

procedures.title: Safety Lock Operation - Grill OFF
steps: Activate lock feature
All control panel functions will be deactivated
Master power button will not function until unlocked
procedures.expected_outcome: Completely locked grill controls

procedures.title: Turning On the Grill
steps: Touch POWER button in main control frame
Hold element power button for 2 seconds
Choose cooking option within 15 seconds
If no selection made within 15 seconds, grill will automatically power off
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill powered on and ready for cooking

procedures.title: Heat Level Cooking Mode Operation
steps: Swipe finger along temperature control arc to desired setting
Alternatively, use + and - signs to select heat level
Observe LED light array for selected setting confirmation
procedures.expected_outcome: Desired heat level is set between LOW-MED-HIGH in 16 increments
error_codes: Element de-powers if set to 0 or inactive for 15 seconds

procedures.title: Temperature Cooking Mode Operation
steps: Touch thermometer/gradient graphic to select temperature mode
Select cooking temperature using + and - buttons or arc swipe
Wait for temperature value to stop flashing (indicates temperature reached)
procedures.expected_outcome: Temperature set between 150°F-550°F (65°C-287°C) in 10°F (12°C) increments

procedures.title: Changing Temperature Units
steps: Touch °F/°C button in main power control frame
procedures.expected_outcome: Temperature units switch between Fahrenheit and Celsius

procedures.title: Setting Cooking Timer
steps: Touch timer clock graphic in element control frame
Set time duration using + and - buttons
Touch timer button to start
Monitor time remaining on display
Wait for automatic shutoff at end of set time
procedures.expected_outcome: Element automatically shuts off when timer reaches zero
error_codes: Timer deactivates after 20 seconds if no time set
Timer shuts off after 30 seconds of inactivity post-completion

procedures.title: Timer Alarm Response
steps: Observe flashing display
Listen for double beep alarm every 10 seconds
Touch power button to stop alarm
Alternatively, wait 3 minutes for automatic deactivation
procedures.expected_outcome: Alarm stops and display returns to normal

procedures.title: Timer Operation
steps: Display will flash when time elapses
Double beep alarm sounds every 10 seconds
Alarm continues until power button is touched or 3 minutes pass
Timer shuts off after 30 seconds of no activity
procedures.expected_outcome: Timer alerts user and automatically shuts off
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Automatic Shut-Off System
steps: Heat settings 1-4 shut off after 90 minutes
Heat settings 5-10 shut off after 70 minutes
Heat settings 11-16 shut off after 60 minutes
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill automatically shuts off after predetermined time based on heat setting
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Temperature Guide Operation
steps: Settings 1-2: Cook fried eggs on griddle
Settings 3-4: Cook pancakes and French toast on griddle
Settings 5-6: Cook vegetables
Settings 7-8: Cook vegetables and fish
Settings 9-10: Cook fish and chicken
Settings 11-12: Cook chicken and hamburgers
Settings 13-14: Cook hamburgers and steaks
Settings 15-16: Cook steaks
procedures.expected_outcome: Food cooked at appropriate temperature setting
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Error Code E04 Resolution
steps: Allow unit to cool
Verify correct cooking utensil type is being used
Lower cooking level or temperature setting
De-power and restart unit to clear display
procedures.expected_outcome: High temperature error resolved
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Error Code E06 Resolution
steps: De-power and restart unit to clear display
Contact Kenyon Customer Care if problem persists
procedures.expected_outcome: Internal electronic control issue addressed
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Error Code E10 Resolution
steps: De-power the unit
Re-power the unit
Command only one control input at a time
procedures.expected_outcome: Multiple control function error resolved
models: Single Zone Grill with IntelliKEN Touch

procedures.title: Heating Element Operation
preconditions: Grill must be cool enough to handle
steps: To raise: Pivot heating element upward until it stays in position
To lower: Apply slight downward pressure on the heating element
procedures.expected_outcome: Heating element moves up and down to allow access to baffle/drip trays

procedures.title: Drip Tray Installation and Preparation
preconditions: Baffle tray must be in place
steps: Position drip tray completely inside the baffle tray
Ensure rim of drip tray does not protrude outside baffle tray
Add 2 cups of water (or enough to cover bottom) before cooking
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly positioned drip tray ready for cooking

procedures.title: Grate Cleaning
preconditions: Grill must be cool enough to handle
steps: Remove grate after use
Wash in warm soapy water
Ensure all residue is removed from non-stick coating
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean grate ready for next use

procedures.title: Lid Removal
preconditions: Grill must be cool before handling
steps: Remove quick release pin from hinge
Grasp lid and lift left side to clear hinge
Slide lid to left until clear of right hinge pin
Wash removed lid in warm, soapy water if needed
procedures.expected_outcome: Lid successfully removed for cleaning

procedures.title: Grill Installation
steps: Unpack grill from shipping container
Verify all components are present
Check electrical supply meets requirements (48V DC 27A or 35V DC-55V DC)
Use 8AWG wire for power supply runs up to 40 feet
Install according to national, state and local codes
Incorporate disconnection means in fixed wiring
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly installed grill ready for use

procedures.title: Electrical Supply Verification
steps: Verify power supply meets requirements: 48V DC 27A for model B70750
For models B70770-B70790, ensure voltage is between 35V DC and 55V DC
For power supply runs up to 40 feet, verify 8AWG wire is used
If specifications don't match, consult licensed electrician
procedures.expected_outcome: Proper electrical supply confirmed for installation

procedures.title: Countertop Installation Clearance Verification
steps: Verify 30 inches minimum clearance between cooking surface and unprotected cabinets
Verify 24 inch minimum clearance if cabinet is protected with flame retardant materials
Ensure 6-inch minimum from backsplash to edge of grill
Confirm 1-1/2 inches minimum from front of counter to grill
Verify 2 inch minimum clearance between grill bottom and combustible surface below
Check for 13 inches maximum depth of overhead cabinets
Confirm 36 inches minimum height of countertop above floor
For Canadian installations, ensure 1/2 inch minimum from any adjacent surface
procedures.expected_outcome: All clearance requirements met for safe installation

procedures.title: Grill Installation
steps: Apply non-adhesive Plumber's Putty around edge of countertop beneath trim flange
Place grill into countertop cutout
Secure grill using four oval head wood screws through mounting flange
Ensure adequate ventilation below countertop
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill securely mounted with proper sealing

procedures.title: Initial Grate Cleaning
preconditions: New grill with nonstick coated grates
steps: Wash grates in warm soapy water before first use
procedures.expected_outcome: Clean, ready-to-use grill grates
models: All Kenyon grills with nonstick grates

procedures.title: Stainless Steel Maintenance
steps: Care for stainless steel monthly as outlined in owner's manual
If corrosion appears, document with photos
Contact company with photo evidence
Request replacement components
procedures.expected_outcome: Rust-free stainless steel components
models: All Kenyon products with stainless steel components

procedures.title: Warranty Service Request
steps: Contact kenyonservice@cookwithkenyon.com
Request return instructions
Return product to company for evaluation
Await repair or replacement determination
procedures.expected_outcome: Warranty service resolution

procedures.title: Cabinet Ventilation Requirements
steps: Ensure cabinet has minimum two openings
Install one opening for fresh air intake
Install second opening for hot air escape
Make each opening 8 square inches for ambient temperatures ≤85ºF/30ºC
Increase opening sizes if ambient temperature >85ºF/30ºC
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly ventilated cabinet installation for optimal grill performance

procedures.title: Countertop Cutout Procedure
steps: Measure cutout dimensions according to provided specifications
Mark corners for radius cuts
Create 1/4 inch radius on corners (or as specified by countertop manufacturer)
Follow manufacturer reinforcement requirements
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly sized and reinforced countertop cutout

procedures.title: Drain Connection Installation
steps: Locate 1/2" NPT brass pipe fitting
Attach 90º brass elbow
Connect 5/8" ID flexible hose
procedures.expected_outcome: Properly connected drain system

procedures.title: Initial Grill Preparation
steps: Remove protective plastic film from lid
Remove protective film from trim flange
Remove protective film from glass panel
Clean grill with stainless steel or glass cleaner
Wash nonstick coated grates in warm soapy water
procedures.expected_outcome: Grill ready for first use

procedures.title: Special Countertop Protection Procedure
preconditions: Granite, marble, quartz, sandstone or Corian countertop
steps: Obtain stain-free Plumber's Putty
Apply putty according to manufacturer instructions
procedures.expected_outcome: Protected countertop surface from potential staining
